headline: Medium prompt-injection and cascading-error risks from shared retrieval-to-analytics workflows; no direct shared channel is documented, so other risks remain limited.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Khoj ingests indexed notes/files and supports RAG/web search, while Superset consumes API-driven analytics content. A plausible pathway exists if Khoj outputs are copied into Superset dashboards or queries and then treated as trusted text. No direct shared channel is documented, so uncertainty pushes this to medium rather than low.
conditions: IF Khoj output is pasted into Superset SQL, dashboard text, or chart annotations without review
IF either agent treats retrieved file content as authoritative instructions
mitigations: Add a manual review step before copying Khoj output into Superset
Use a fixed prompt template that strips instructions from retrieved text
Disable automatic ingestion of free-form notes into analytics fields
requires-engineering: add provenance labels from Khoj into downstream workflows

B_data_leakage.rationale: Khoj reads personal notes and indexed documents, but Superset’s profile does not show file ingestion or sensitive-data handling by default. The pair lacks a documented shared workspace or OAuth principal, so leakage is possible mainly through manual transfer of content, which keeps blast radius small.
conditions: IF personal notes from Khoj are manually copied into Superset datasets or SQL text
IF Superset is configured to display those copied contents to broader audiences
mitigations: Avoid placing personal notes into shared Superset datasets
Restrict dashboard access to the smallest audience
Redact sensitive fields before import
Use separate accounts for note retrieval and analytics
requires-engineering: enforce data-class tagging at import

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Khoj has read-only filesystem access and no git or write capability, while Superset exposes only an API and allowlisted egress. There is no overlapping unrestricted write surface in the profiles, so direct resource contention is limited to unusual shared backends or manual coordination.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable backend through external configuration
IF an operator manually synchronizes state between Khoj and Superset
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate storage backends
Avoid granting Superset write access to Khoj-managed files
Review any shared database credentials before deployment
requires-engineering: add locking around any shared mutable resource

D_cascading_error.rationale: Khoj can surface retrieved facts from notes and documents, and Superset can render or act on API-fed analytics content. If Khoj output is used as input to Superset without verification, errors can cascade into misleading dashboards or decisions. The pairwise pathway is plausible in default workflows, so medium is warranted.
conditions: IF Superset dashboards or queries are populated from Khoj-generated summaries
IF no human verification occurs before publication or action
mitigations: Require source links on any Khoj-derived summary
Verify key facts against original documents before publishing
Limit Superset to read-only consumption of reviewed data
Add a checklist for dashboard publication
requires-engineering: implement citation-preserving export from Khoj

E_compliance.rationale: Khoj explicitly touches personal notes and indexed documents, while Superset’s profile does not specify residency, retention, or regulated-data controls. The only concrete compliance concern is a potential mismatch if personal data is moved from Khoj into Superset; the other agent is not cited because its profile lacks a specific residency or certification claim.
conditions: IF personal notes containing regulated data are exported from Khoj into Superset
IF Superset is used in a jurisdiction or retention regime incompatible with the source data
mitigations: Do not move regulated data into Superset without a policy review
Minimize retention of imported note content
Document the data class before export
Use separate environments for personal notes and analytics
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls to the pipeline
